env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^jsonv2=on$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/jsonv2default

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Printf("jsonv2=%s\n", mode)
}

-- mode_off.go --
//go:build !goexperiment.jsonv2

package main

const mode = "off"

-- mode_on.go --
//go:build goexperiment.jsonv2

package main

const mode = "on"
